explication: This repository is a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) learning course. A learner studies the curriculum, applies Kubernetes concepts through YAML and command-line exercises, provisions or connects to a cluster, then practices troubleshooting and exam scenarios to build administrator readiness. The README documents broad coverage from fundamentals through security, storage, networking, maintenance, and managed-cluster installation. The tree supports these educational branches, while sampled source was limited to a lab-script generator and does not establish additional runtime wiring.
